commit.message: Release commit for Kubernetes v1.36.5
Release commit for Kubernetes v1.36.5

scheduler: fix negative namespace selector evaluation

Restore pointer-based mutation when namespace selectors are expanded into explicit namespace sets. Passing AffinityTerm by value left the original NamespaceSelector intact, causing negative selectors to be evaluated again against empty namespace labels.

This is the minimal correctness fix extracted from fb74900c5341043b3f1a6c47bd88f3d69f499328 without the InterPodAffinityHostnameFastPath changes.

Signed-off-by: Rahul <rahulbabu95@gmail.com>

scheduler: fix negative namespace selector evaluation

Restore pointer-based mutation when namespace selectors are expanded into explicit namespace sets. Passing AffinityTerm by value left the original NamespaceSelector intact, causing negative selectors to be evaluated again against empty namespace labels.

This is the minimal correctness fix extracted from fb74900c5341043b3f1a6c47bd88f3d69f499328 without the InterPodAffinityHostnameFastPath changes.

Signed-off-by: Rahul <rahulbabu95@gmail.com>

commit.message:
Fix flapping pod.status.resourceClaimStatuses

resourceclaimcontroller: fix incorrect SSA apply in syncPod method

The ResourceClaimController's syncPod method only includes new
resource claims in the server-side apply, not existing claims. Since
this controller is the owning fieldManager, SSA removes the missing
existing keys. This results in flapping between claims when more than
one claim is assigned to the Pod.

This fix includes the existing claims in the SSA request.

Signed-off-by: John Belamaric <jbelamaric@google.com>

Move detectNumCPU() into conntrackConfigurer interface

So that TestSetupConntrack() can control it

Move hashsize parameter setting out of SetMax

Have setSysctls() make a separate call to set hashsize, so that we can
test the handling of nf_conntrack_max and hashsize separately.
Don't set nf_conntrack_max if it's already larger than needed
Update CHANGELOG/CHANGELOG-1.36.md for v1.36.5
job controller: clear expectations when deleting Job
job controller: extend recreation regression coverage
job controller: simplify recreation regression test

apiserver: accept large identity header sets with Go 1.27

Go 1.27 rejects requests with more than 500 header values by default
(http.Server.MaxHeaderValueCount, golang/go#79936). Impersonation and
request-header authentication send one header line per group, so a
user with about 500 groups receives HTTP 431 before authentication
runs.

Set MaxHeaderValueCount to 16384 for secure and deprecated insecure
serving: 1 MiB MaxHeaderBytes at about 64 bytes per value (~16 for the
header name and ~48 for the value). This stays bounded while allowing
identities with thousands of groups.

The field is new in Go 1.27, so it is set through setMaxHeaderValueCount,
with a go1.27 build-tagged implementation and a no-op for older Go, so
the change backports to release branches built with Go 1.26.

images follow when published.

+## Changelog since v1.36.4

+## Changes by Kind
+
+### Feature
+
+- Kubernetes is now built using Go 1.26.8 ([#142180](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/142180), [@cpanato](https://github.com/cpanato)) [SIG Release and Testing]
+
+### Failing Test
+
+- Three conformance tests added in 1.35 that are not interoperable with static CPU manager are demoted to regular e2e tests ([#141603](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/141603), [@natasha41575](https://github.com/natasha41575)) [SIG Architecture, Node and Testing]
+
+### Bug or Regression
+
+- Fixed a panic in the Windows kube-proxy (winkernel) that could terminate kube-proxy when an HNS load balancer without port mappings was enumerated. ([#141707](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/141707), [@prince-melvin](https://github.com/prince-melvin)) [SIG Network and Windows]
+- Kube-scheduler: a ResourceClaim whose device request counts add up past the int range no longer crashes the scheduler or skips the `firstAvailable` fallback in the DRA allocator. A request over the per-claim device limit is rejected with an error naming it, and an oversized `firstAvailable` alternative falls through to a smaller one. ([#141923](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/141923), [@thc1006](https://github.com/thc1006)) [SIG Node]
+- Kubeadm: no longer persists a node-specific systemd-resolved resolvConf path in the cluster-wide kubelet-config ConfigMap during init. ([#141628](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/141628), [@HirazawaUi](https://github.com/HirazawaUi)) [SIG Cluster Lifecycle]
